name: x-multi-fault
note: Hard (diagnose): a red+green science block into 2 labs that looks finished but has 4 independent faults: a belt tile facing back on the red input belt, the gear assembler set to pipes, the pole over the 2 green assemblers missing, and the furnaces' plate chest full of stone. The player only says science is slow. Met = 2 red and 2 green assemblers producing (red not hand-stocked) and both labs holding both packs, for 2 samples. Records which faults got fixed.
setup_lua:
-- Shared helpers for the x-* harder scenarios (pasted at the top of each setup_lua by x-gen.py). Positions are
-- absolute; each setup picks its own origin with find_near/find_ring and adds offsets.
-- open(x, y, w, h): no water, ore or buildings in the box (trees and rocks get cleared).
-- find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax): the open box nearest to cx,cy (spiral search), generating chunks as needed.
-- find_ring(w, h, r0, r1): an open box between r0 and r1 tiles from the origin.
local s, f = game.surfaces.nauvis, game.forces.player
local D = defines.direction
local LAB = s.get_tile(200, 200).name == "landfill" -- the flat lab stage (448x448 landfill around spawn)
local function gen(x, y, w, h)
  local need = false
  for cx = math.floor(x / 32), math.floor((x + w) / 32) do
    for cy = math.floor(y / 32), math.floor((y + h) / 32) do
      if not s.is_chunk_generated { cx, cy } then
        s.request_to_generate_chunks({ cx * 32 + 16, cy * 32 + 16 }, 0)
        need = true
      end
    end
  end
  if need then s.force_generate_chunk_requests() end
end
local function open(x, y, w, h)
  gen(x, y, w, h)
  local a = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } }
  if s.count_tiles_filtered { area = a, collision_mask = "water_tile" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "resource" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "cliff" } > 0 then return false end
  return s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, invert = true,
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "corpse", "fish", "item-entity", "character" } } == 0
end
local function find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax)
  cx, cy = math.floor(cx), math.floor(cy)
  if open(cx, cy, w, h) then return cx, cy end
  for r = 4, rmax or 60, 4 do
    for i = -r, r, 4 do
      for _, p in pairs { { cx + i, cy - r }, { cx + i, cy + r }, { cx - r, cy + i }, { cx + r, cy + i } } do
        if open(p[1], p[2], w, h) then return p[1], p[2] end
      end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area near " .. cx .. "," .. cy)
end
local function find_ring(w, h, r0, r1)
  for r = r0, r1, 6 do
    for _, d in pairs { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0.7, 0.7 }, { -0.7, 0.7 }, { 0.7, -0.7 },
      { -0.7, -0.7 } } do
      local x, y = math.floor(d[1] * r), math.floor(d[2] * r)
      if open(x, y, w, h) then return x, y end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area " .. r0 .. "-" .. r1 .. " tiles out")
end
local function clear(x, y, w, h)
  for _, e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered { area = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } },
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "item-entity", "corpse" } }) do e.destroy() end
end
local function put(name, x, y, dir, extra)
  local spec = { name = name, position = { x, y }, direction = dir, force = f }
  for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do spec[k] = v end
  local e = s.create_entity(spec)
  if not e then error("could not place " .. name .. " at " .. x .. "," .. y) end
  return e
end
local function source(x, y, items) -- an infinity chest that never runs out of each item in `items`
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  for i, it in ipairs(items) do
    c.set_infinity_container_filter(i, { name = it, count = 50, mode = "exactly", index = i })
  end
  return c
end
local function sink(x, y) -- an infinity chest that deletes whatever goes in
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  c.remove_unfiltered_items = true
  return c
end
local function grid(x, y, watts) -- an always-on power source, a corner of the main grid
  local e = put("electric-energy-interface", x, y)
  e.power_production, e.electric_buffer_size = (watts or 6000000) / 60, 10000000
  return e
end
local function gps(x, y) return math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y) end

-- x-multi-fault setup: a small science block that looks finished but has four independent faults.
-- Red: copper (infinity chest) and gears share one belt into 2 red assemblers. Gears come from a gear assembler
-- fed by a plate chest that 2 stone furnaces fill. Green: 2 assemblers fed from chests. Both put packs on a
-- science belt that runs past 2 labs into an overflow sink, so production never backs up.
-- Faults: (1) one belt tile on the red input belt faces west; (2) the gear assembler makes pipes;
-- (3) the pole over the green assemblers is missing; (4) the plate chest is full of stone, so both furnaces sit on
-- full output. Fixing all four gets red and green packs into both labs.
local fx, fy = find_ring(34, 18, 40, 220)
clear(fx, fy, 34, 18)
local X, Y = fx + 9, fy - 1
local function at(name, x, y, dir, extra) return put(name, X + x, Y + y, dir, extra) end

grid(X - 1, Y + 3, 2000000)
for _, p in pairs { { -2.5, 5.5 }, { 2.5, 5.5 }, { 7.5, 8.5 }, { 14.5, 9.5 }, { 19.5, 9.5 } } do
  at("medium-electric-pole", p[1], p[2])
end

-- smelting pair -> plate chest -> gear assembler
local f1, f2 = at("stone-furnace", -5, 7), at("stone-furnace", -3, 10)
source(X - 7.5, Y + 7.5, { "iron-ore" })
source(X - 5.5, Y + 9.5, { "iron-ore" })
for _, b in pairs { at("burner-inserter", -6.5, 7.5, D.west), at("burner-inserter", -4.5, 9.5, D.west) } do
  b.insert { name = "coal", count = 20 }
end
for _, fu in pairs { f1, f2 } do
  fu.insert { name = "coal", count = 50 }
  fu.get_output_inventory().insert { name = "iron-plate", count = 100 }
end
local chest = at("wooden-chest", -2.5, 7.5)
chest.insert { name = "stone", count = 800 } -- fault 4
at("inserter", -3.5, 7.5, D.west)
at("inserter", -2.5, 8.5, D.south)
at("inserter", -1.5, 7.5, D.west)
local gear = at("assembling-machine-1", 0.5, 7.5)
gear.set_recipe("pipe") -- fault 2
at("inserter", 0.5, 5.5, D.south)

-- red: copper + gears on one belt
source(X + 1.5, Y + 2.5, { "copper-plate" })
at("inserter", 1.5, 3.5, D.north)
for x = 0, 11 do at("transport-belt", x + 0.5, 4.5, D.east) end
s.find_entity("transport-belt", { X + 3.5, Y + 4.5 }).direction = D.west -- fault 1
for _, x in pairs { 5.5, 9.5 } do
  at("assembling-machine-1", x, 7.5).set_recipe("automation-science-pack")
  at("inserter", x, 5.5, D.north)
  at("inserter", x, 9.5, D.north)
end

-- green: chest-fed assemblers (their pole at 7.5,15.5 is missing: fault 3)
for _, x in pairs { 5.5, 9.5 } do
  at("assembling-machine-1", x, 13.5).set_recipe("logistic-science-pack")
  at("inserter", x, 11.5, D.south)
  at("inserter", x, 15.5, D.south)
  source(X + x, Y + 16.5, { "inserter", "transport-belt" })
end

-- science belt -> 2 labs -> overflow sink
for x = 4, 20 do at("transport-belt", x + 0.5, 10.5, D.east) end
at("lab", 16.5, 7.5)
at("lab", 16.5, 13.5)
at("inserter", 16.5, 9.5, D.south)
at("inserter", 16.5, 11.5, D.north)
at("inserter", 21.5, 10.5, D.west)
sink(X + 22.5, Y + 10.5)

-- research that needs both packs, if one is open
local function both(t)
  local ing = t.research_unit_ingredients
  if #ing ~= 2 then return false end
  local n = 0
  for _, i in pairs(ing) do
    if i.name == "automation-science-pack" or i.name == "logistic-science-pack" then n = n + 1 end
  end
  return n == 2
end
local tech
for _, t in pairs(f.technologies) do
  if not tech and t.enabled and not t.researched and both(t) then
    local ok = true
    for _, p in pairs(t.prerequisites) do if not p.researched then ok = false end end
    if ok then tech = t end
  end
end
if tech then
  f.cancel_current_research()
  f.add_research(tech)
end

storage.bench_mf = {
  X = X, Y = Y, area = { { X - 9, Y + 1 }, { X + 24, Y + 18 } },
  red = { { X + 3, Y + 5 }, { X + 12, Y + 10 } }, green = { { X + 3, Y + 11.5 }, { X + 12, Y + 16 } },
  labs = { { X + 14, Y + 5 }, { X + 19, Y + 16 } }, row = { { X, Y + 4 }, { X + 12, Y + 5 } },
  gear = { X + 0.5, Y + 7.5 }, chest = { X - 2.5, Y + 7.5 },
}
return { gx = math.floor(X + 8), gy = math.floor(Y + 10), tech = tech and tech.name or "none" }

objectives.name: science-flowing
objectives.goal: @{agent} science is really slow at the little lab setup at [gps={gx},{gy}]. Can you look at it and get it running properly?
objectives.answer: Your call. Everything it needs is there, something's just broken. Don't hand-feed it.

score.name: red_producing
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_mf b.seen=b.seen or {} local n=0 for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=b.area, type='assembling-machine'}) do local r=e.get_recipe() if r and r.name=='automation-science-pack' then local p=e.products_finished if p>(b.seen[e.unit_number] or 0) and not (function() for _,i in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type='inserter', area={{e.position.x-3,e.position.y-3},{e.position.x+3,e.position.y+3}}}) do if i.drop_target==e then local t=i.pickup_target if t and (t.type=='container' or t.type=='logistic-container') then return true end end end return false end)() then n=n+1 end b.seen[e.unit_number]=p end end return n

score.name: green_producing
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_mf b.seen=b.seen or {} local n=0 for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=b.area, type='assembling-machine'}) do local r=e.get_recipe() if r and r.name=='logistic-science-pack' then local p=e.products_finished if p>(b.seen[e.unit_number] or 0) then n=n+1 end b.seen[e.unit_number]=p end end return n

score.name: labs_supplied
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_mf local n=0 for _,l in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=b.area, type='lab'}) do local i=l.get_inventory(defines.inventory.lab_input) if i and i.get_item_count('automation-science-pack')>0 and i.get_item_count('logistic-science-pack')>0 then n=n+1 end end return n

score.name: fixed_belt
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_mf local n=0 for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=b.row, name='transport-belt'}) do if e.direction==defines.direction.east then n=n+1 end end return n>=12 and 1 or 0

score.name: fixed_recipe
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_mf local g=s.find_entities_filtered{position=b.gear, radius=0.6, type='assembling-machine'}[1] local r=g and g.get_recipe() return r and r.name=='iron-gear-wheel' and 1 or 0

score.name: fixed_power
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_mf local n=0 for _,e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=b.area, type='assembling-machine'}) do local r=e.get_recipe() if r and r.name=='logistic-science-pack' and e.is_connected_to_electric_network() then n=n+1 end end return n>=2 and 1 or 0

score.name: fixed_chest
score.lua: local b=storage.bench_mf local n=0 for _,c in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area=b.area, type='container'}) do n=n+c.get_item_count('stone') end return n==0 and 1 or 0

objectives.selftest_lua: local b=storage.bench_mf local X,Y=b.X,b.Y s.find_entity('transport-belt',{X+3.5,Y+4.5}).direction=defines.direction.east s.find_entities_filtered{position=b.gear, radius=0.6, type='assembling-machine'}[1].set_recipe('iron-gear-wheel') s.create_entity{name='medium-electric-pole', position={X+7.5,Y+15.5}, force='player'} s.find_entities_filtered{position=b.chest, radius=0.6, name='wooden-chest'}[1].get_inventory(defines.inventory.chest).clear() return 'fixed'
